peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.8% above its local comparables; 96 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (41.7): 2.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 166 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 70 m, Havelock MRT about 530 m; closer than 545 of 551 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 360 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 160 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 310 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 1,100 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (River Green, 34 new sales, about 70 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 300 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 360 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 460 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 480 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 700 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 790 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,020 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 329 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,447 new sales and 1,183 resales (2,630 purchases); new sales were 55% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,770 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,860 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,183 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 441 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,183 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,326 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.8%). Planning-area private resales −25.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
